rows.text: Blameless AARs, post-mortems, flaw-scan synthesis. Synced from `peer_debrief.py` — do not delete history.

**Factory Engineer triage:** 7 med reviews converge on worktree pool maturity: inventory without verify-per-tree, registry binding, or adapt handshake. No high severity. Core gap is proving pool + external proof loop, not more peer_loop ref

**Verify Runner triage:** 3 high: role bleed (implement work assigned to verify niche), verify gate failures blocking factory, no parallel verify. Consensus: stay read-only, own execution speed and first-failure reporting.
**Adapt & Heal Specialist triage:** 1 high on external proof prerequisite. Hub fingerprint heal detected but not closed; registry repos lack profiles. Adapt is upstream gate for factory capex.
**Research Analyst triage:** 2 high: executable queue demotion stalled; duplicate external proof and factory phase lines persist. Success = fewer peer-executable items with clear acceptance criteria.
**Queue Steward triage:** 4 med: sync maintained but dirty-tree item conflates solved dispatch-unblock with optional hygiene; duplicate factory items inflate noop risk.

**OSS Integration Architect triage:** 5 high — highest factory blocker. Zero external proof loops; registry RAM/CaaS/CPT lack artifacts. Investment thesis unvalidated until one adapt→native-verify→PR completes.
**Performance Tuner triage:** 6 med: quick cache partial; dual daemon; verify still sequential. Perf wins should target verify wall-clock and external proof cycle time.
**Safety Auditor triage:** 5 med: role scope bleed — assigned git hygiene not SAFETY_GATES audit. continue_on_dirty design needs PASS/BLOCK on worktree isolate, not dispatch unblocking.
